Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

openlineage (development version)

  • The test suite no longer depends on how R parses long decimal literals, so it passes on platforms without long doubles (CRAN noLD check, #96).

openlineage 0.2.0

CRAN release: 2026-11-19

Breaking changes

  • ol_facet() takes schema_url after ..., so a field such as schema is no longer matched to it partially. Passing the URL first, or as schema_url =, works as before (#29).

  • HttpTransport no longer follows redirects. A 3xx response raises an openlineage_http_error carrying its status_code, instead of resending the event without its body, or a credential header to another host (#21).

  • Values that were written silently wrong are now an openlineage_validation_error:

    • in ol_facet(): infinite numbers, complex and raw vectors, named atomic vectors, lists with repeated or empty names, classed lists, other classed objects, and Date values that are infinite or outside the years 0001 to 9999 (#30, #64, #65);
    • anywhere: strings that are not valid UTF-8 (#31, #63);
    • integer fields above 2^53 and negative input and output statistics counts (#22, #46).

  • HttpTransport$new() checks that timeout is between 0.001 and 2147483 seconds (#27). It rejects a url or endpoint with a query or fragment marker, whitespace, control characters, or . and .. segments, also when percent-encoded (#28). It rejects headers that set Content-Length, Transfer-Encoding, Host or another header that frames the request (#62).

  • Passing transport together with HTTP arguments is an error also when the client is disabled (#34).

  • openlineage now requires httr2 1.2.0 or later (#70).

New features

  • New ColumnLineageDatasetFacet(), with ColumnLineageInputField() and ColumnLineageTransformation(), for column-level lineage (facet schema 1-2-0). Output matches the OpenLineage Python client (#16).

  • New OpenLineageClient$close(), which closes the client’s transport and raises an openlineage_transport_error if that fails (#47, #66).

  • POSIXct and POSIXlt values in ol_facet() are written as event times. The mapping of R values to JSON is documented in ?ol_facet (#30, #51, #65).

  • event@event_type <- "COMPLETE" converts the string to a RunState, and x@facets <- list() is accepted and written as {} (#25).

Bug fixes

  • Numbers are serialized without loss: integer-valued doubles up to 2^53 exactly, other doubles with the fewest digits that read back as the same value, as the Python client does (#22).

  • new_event_time() no longer emits one millisecond low for about half of all times, and raises an openlineage_validation_error outside the years 0001 to 9999 (#23, #50).

  • Condition messages show user-supplied text, such as column names with braces, literally instead of interpolating it (#24).

  • Assigning a property with @<- runs the same checks as the constructor and raises openlineage_validation_error: dataset roles in RunEvent@inputs and @outputs, the tag field restriction, and ColumnLineageDatasetFacet@fields (#25).

  • A 429 or 503 response with a Retry-After date and no Date header is retried, instead of failing as if no response had arrived. Retry-After accepts seconds and all three HTTP-date forms, and an unreadable value falls back to back-off without a warning (#26, #49, #61, #67).

  • A connection failure carries the curl error, with no credentials, as parent (#26).

  • Non-ASCII text is sent as UTF-8 in every locale, including LC_ALL=C (#63).

  • ?HttpTransport documents the retry delays and that delivery is at least once (#48).
